blocks.heading: FinTech and Payments (Atlanta's 'Transaction Alley')
paragraphs: Atlanta processes a remarkable share of global electronic payments — Global Payments (Atlanta HQ, processes billions of transactions annually), NCR Voyix (Atlanta HQ, ATM and POS technology leader), Cardlytics (Atlanta HQ, purchase intelligence analytics), Fiserv (significant Atlanta presence), and hundreds of FinTech companies have made Atlanta the world's 'Transaction Alley':

Payment fraud detection: Real-time transaction fraud scoring for Global Payments' enormous merchant acquiring portfolio — at the throughput and latency that billion-transaction-per-year processing requires.
Purchase analytics: Cardlytics-adjacent purchase intelligence analytics using card transaction data for consumer insights and targeted marketing.
Credit risk and underwriting: ML for small business and consumer lending at Atlanta's FinTech companies building on the established payment infrastructure.
Cost: $45,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Healthcare
paragraphs: Emory Healthcare (Emory University academic medical center, one of the Southeast's leading academic health systems), Piedmont Healthcare (Atlanta HQ, 24-hospital system), Northside Hospital, and Children's Healthcare of Atlanta. HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Atlanta's excellent health systems.
Cost: $50,000–$135,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks

UPS's Atlanta distribution hub and CHEP pallet management operations add supply chain AI demand.
Cost: $40,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks

sections.title: Atlanta AI Regulatory Context
sections.description: Key legal and compliance considerations for Atlanta AI development.

blocks.heading: Georgia Consumer Protection
paragraphs: Georgia's consumer protection laws apply to Atlanta's consumer-facing AI. Georgia does not yet have a comprehensive consumer privacy law (as of 2025) — simplifying some compliance requirements relative to California or Virginia.

blocks.heading: Georgia Department of Banking and Finance
paragraphs: Atlanta's FinTech companies operating as lenders or money transmitters in Georgia face GDBF regulation — ClickMasters designs Atlanta FinTech AI with GDBF and relevant federal (CFPB, FinCEN) oversight in mind.
